item.title: ExemploCorp VPN Gateway zero-day exploited in the wild to deploy ransomware
item.description: Attackers are chaining CVE-2026-90001 with stolen credentials to deploy ransomware on corporate networks. The vendor has released version 9.4.2 and urges all customers to update immediately.

item.title: Data breach at AcmeSoft exposes records of 2 million customers
item.description: The company confirmed that an unauthorized party accessed a customer database containing names, email addresses and hashed passwords. Notification emails are being sent to affected users.

item.title: New Android banking trojan spreads through fake update pages
item.description: Researchers describe a trojan that overlays banking apps and intercepts one-time codes. It is distributed through websites that imitate system update notices.

item.title: Weekly roundup: patches, leaks and arrests
item.description: A summary of the week's security news, including several vendor patches and two arrests linked to credential theft.
